title: The Karnataka Cine and Cultural Activists (Welfare) Bill, 2024
summary: 'The Karnataka Cine and Cultural Activists (Welfare) Bill, 2024' (Bill No. 28 of 2024) is a State legislative measure introduced in the Karnataka Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha) concerning Labour, Employment & Gig Economy. The bill establishes a substantive legal framework creating new state statutory standards, definitions, and administrative governance.
